info.title: Takar Second Opinion
info.description: A second opinion for any Telegraph intent, in one call. Takar asks two different Telegraph miners, chosen by an open on-chain record of who was right (EAS on Ethereum Sepolia), and tells you whether they agree. It never averages: a disagreement comes back with both answers and the fields that differ. Free to call; Takar pays the asks in test USDC. Testnet only. Built for Telegraph Hackathon Season II, which pays cash prizes.

post.summary: Ask two independent Telegraph miners the same question and compare their answers
post.description: Use this before acting on intelligence from Telegraph: prices, weather, sanctions, event outcomes, on-chain facts, any intent. If verdict is 'agree', act on 'answer'. If 'disagree', do not act on either answer alone: report both and the differing fields. If 'insufficient', fewer than two usable answers were available.
